# Wax In The City SL

> Sri Lanka's premier ladies-only waxing, facial, and body ritual studio in Colombo. Renowned for strict hygiene protocols, private appointment-led rooms, and world-class Lycon (Australia) and Rica (Italy) waxes.

## Overview
- **Brand Name**: Wax In The City SL
- **Target Audience**: Ladies only (female clients only; private, therapist-matched appointments).
- **Core Standard**: Strict hygiene protocol — single-use spatulas, fresh wax every dip, no double-dipping, and disposable bed covers.
- **Locations**: Two studios in Colombo, Sri Lanka (Battaramulla and Nugegoda).
- **Official Website**: https://waxinthecity.lk
- **Online Booking**: https://waxinthecity.lk/book

---

## Studio Branches

### Battaramulla Studio
- **Address**: 15, 3 Centre Rd, Battaramulla 10120, Sri Lanka
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +94 77 946 9437
- **Operating Hours**: 9:00 AM – 10:00 PM (Monday – Sunday; Closed on Poya days & public holidays)
- **Features**: Calm private suites, full waxing menu, facials, Moroccan body rituals, and Japanese spa bed.

### Nugegoda Studio
- **Address**: High Level Road Area, Nugegoda, Colombo, Sri Lanka
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +94 76 494 8107
- **Operating Hours**: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM (Monday – Sunday; Closed on Poya days & public holidays)
- **Features**: Intimate private suites, complete waxing services, and facial glow-ups.

---

## Wax Products & Standards

1. **Lycon (Australia)**: Stripless hot wax formulated with soothing chamomile, rose, and aloe vera. Used for sensitive and intimate zones (Brazilian, Bikini, Underarms, Eyebrows, and Face). Never pulls delicate skin.
2. **Rica (Italy)**: 98% natural-origin liposoluble strip wax infused with white chocolate and vegetable oils. Colophony-free for soft, irritation-free arm and leg waxing.
3. **Brazil Gold**: Trusted salon-standard golden polymer wax for routine maintenance.
